findings.affected_requirement: AC-7, FR-017, SC-006, plan final-transaction recovery, data-model final persistence failure, T002-T004 and T044
findings.evidence: PersistCompletedProfileAsync includes both SaveChangesAsync and transaction CommitAsync at src/dotnet/Vulgata.Infrastructure/Data/ScanRunRepository.cs:38-60, but the coordinator invokes recovery only for DbUpdateException or InvalidOperationException at src/dotnet/Vulgata.Web/Data/RepositoryProfilingCoordinator.cs:588-623. A commit failure such as a provider/database IOException, timeout, or provider-specific DbException falls through the outer catch at lines 638-646; because the in-memory ScanRun is already Completed, no failure is persisted and the durable rolled-back ScanRun remains Profiling. The only injected test throws DbUpdateException at tests/Vulgata.Tests/RepositoryProfilingTests.cs:2548-2552.
findings.correction_outcome: Route every non-cancellation failure from the final aggregate persistence/commit boundary through rollback, ChangeTracker clearing, durable Profiling reload, and one sanitized Failed transition; add a regression RED using a non-DbUpdate commit failure and rerun atomicity, persistence, and full verification.

findings.location: NuGet lock pairing and same-root ambiguity, lines 141-157 and 238-289
findings.affected_requirement: AC-3, AC-5, FR-011, FR-014, SC-003, and framework-detection scope rules 4-5
findings.evidence: The contract requires a lock to pair to a supported direct manifest at the same root and same-ecosystem same-winning-root ambiguity to create no fact (specs/002-language-framework-detection/contracts/framework-detection.md:63-65). The detector accepts a packages.lock.json when any .csproj exists at that root (FrameworkEvidenceDetector.cs:141-148,1089-1094), but later detects ambiguity by counting only direct PackageEvidence artifacts in the winning facts (lines 249-254). With two .csproj files at one root that contain no catalog-matched direct fact and one lock containing a matched transitive coordinate, manifestCount is zero, the lock is accepted, and a Medium framework fact is applied even though the owning project cannot be determined. Existing ambiguity coverage uses two projects that each already emit a direct matched fact (FrameworkDetectionTests.cs:671-700), so it does not cover this escape.
findings.correction_outcome: Carry supported manifest identity independently of matched framework facts, require an unambiguous same-root lock-to-manifest pairing before accepting transitive evidence, emit the bounded ambiguity outcome, and add a regression fixture with multiple same-root .csproj files plus lock-only matched evidence.
